We search for an alchemy to balance pain with joy, believing every soul has a price. But the ultimate truth isn't found at the Gate—it's realizing that humanity cannot be calculated. We are not made of iron and bone alone, but of the scars we survive and the warm, fragile hands we choose to hold in the dust.
